column1: # Model ids for the ai-models rules, as of 2026-10-26, from Anthropic's model deprecations page
# deprecations page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations). Regenerate the rules after an
# edit: bun scripts/models.ts (tests/spec/13-packs.test.ts fails while they differ).
# status: active | deprecated (still served, retires on <retires>) | retired (every call fails).
# An id ending in * also covers its suffixed variants (gpt-4-turbo* covers gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09).
# rejects: request features the API rejects (400) on the model: budget_tokens (thinking type
